text: Core Scientific, Inc. is a Nasdaq-listed (CORZ) bitcoin miner and data-centre operator. Per its 2026 proxy statement, its 5%+ holders are The Vanguard Group (10.8%), Situational Awareness (9.1%), Pentwater Capital Management (8.3%), BlackRock (7.4%), Two Seas Capital (5.5%), Susquehanna Securities (5.5%) and Citadel Securities (5.4%); no state shareholder is identified. A proposed 2025 all-stock acquisition by CoreWeave was terminated in October 2025 after stockholders voted against it.

source.name: Core Scientific, Inc. 2026 Proxy Statement (DEF 14A, SEC EDGAR)
